explainer_content.short_definition: Detroit soul-pop precision: Black vocal brilliance, studio discipline, and hooks built for crossover impact.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Motown turned a Detroit house studio into a national hit factory, pairing songwriters, arrangers, house musicians, and artist development into a repeatable pop-soul machine.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It changed the sound of American pop and created a model for Black music crossing radio boundaries without losing identity.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The groove is tight, the chorus is instant, and every part sounds arranged for lift.
